---
title: Group skills
---

The group maintains a set of shared *skills* for Claude Code in the
[group-skills](https://github.com/tolborg-group/group-skills) repository. A
skill is a set of instructions for a particular kind of task, e.g. syncing a
git repository or finding out why a LaTeX document does not compile. You can
call a skill by name, e.g. `/git:sync`, and Claude also picks one up on its own
when you describe a task the skill covers.

The skills are grouped into *plugins* that are installed separately, and the
repository is a plugin *marketplace* that Claude Code can install them from.

## Setup

Add the marketplace once, in a terminal:

```bash
claude plugin marketplace add tolborg-group/group-skills
```

Then install the plugins you want with the commands listed below, or run
`/plugin` inside Claude Code and browse the marketplace.

Updates are not automatic by default. Either run `claude plugin update` with
the name of the plugin, e.g. `claude plugin update git@tolborg-group`, or turn
on auto-update for the marketplace under **Marketplaces** in `/plugin`.

## Available skills

The overview below is read from the repository every time the handbook is
rendered.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

# Reads the plugins and skills from the main branch of the group-skills
# repository and prints them as Markdown.

import io
import json
import os
import re
import tarfile
import urllib.request
from pathlib import PurePosixPath

import yaml

REPO = "tolborg-group/group-skills"
BRANCH = "main"
ARCHIVE_URL = f"https://codeload.github.com/{REPO}/tar.gz/refs/heads/{BRANCH}"
REPO_URL = f"https://github.com/{REPO}"


def download_repo():
    """Return the files of the repository as {path relative to repo root: content}."""
    with urllib.request.urlopen(ARCHIVE_URL, timeout=30) as response:
        archive = response.read()
    files = {}
    with tarfile.open(fileobj=io.BytesIO(archive), mode="r:gz") as tar:
        for member in tar:
            if member.isfile():
                # Drop the "<repo>-<branch>/" directory the archive wraps everything in.
                path = PurePosixPath(*PurePosixPath(member.name).parts[1:])
                files[str(path)] = tar.extractfile(member).read()
    return files


def frontmatter(text):
    match = re.match(r"^---\s*\n(.*?)\n---\s*(\n|$)", text, re.DOTALL)
    return (yaml.safe_load(match.group(1)) or {}) if match else {}


def escape(text):
    """Make free text safe to place in Markdown (no accidental math, citations, markup)."""
    text = " ".join(str(text).split())
    return re.sub(r"([\\`*_{}\[\]<>|$@~^#])", r"\\\1", text)


def first_sentence(text):
    """Return the first sentence of a description, for the overview table."""
    text = " ".join(str(text).split())
    match = re.match(r"(.+?[.!?])(\s|$)", text)
    return match.group(1) if match else text


def build_markdown(files):
    marketplace = json.loads(files[".claude-plugin/marketplace.json"])
    overview = ["| Skill | Plugin | Description |", "|---|---|---|"]
    sections = []

    for plugin in marketplace["plugins"]:
        name = plugin["name"]
        root = str(PurePosixPath(plugin["source"]))  # "./plugins/git" -> "plugins/git"
        description = plugin.get("description")
        if not description:
            manifest = files.get(f"{root}/.claude-plugin/plugin.json")
            description = json.loads(manifest).get("description", "") if manifest else ""

        plugin_id = f"plugin-{name}"
        sections += [f"### {name} {{#{plugin_id}}}", ""]
        if description:
            sections += [escape(description), ""]
        sections += [
            "```bash",
            f"claude plugin install {name}@{marketplace['name']}",
            "```",
            "",
        ]

        skill_files = sorted(
            path
            for path in files
            if path.startswith(f"{root}/skills/") and path.endswith("/SKILL.md")
        )
        for path in skill_files:
            meta = frontmatter(files[path].decode("utf-8"))
            skill = meta.get("name") or PurePosixPath(path).parent.name
            skill_id = f"skill-{name}-{skill}"
            skill_description = meta.get("description", "")
            overview.append(
                f"| [`/{name}:{skill}`](#{skill_id}) "
                f"| [{escape(name)}](#{plugin_id}) "
                f"| {escape(first_sentence(skill_description))} |"
            )
            sections += [
                f"[[`/{name}:{skill}`]({REPO_URL}/blob/{BRANCH}/{path})]{{#{skill_id}}}",
                f":   {escape(skill_description)}",
                "",
            ]

    overview = ["::: {.skills-overview}", "", *overview, "", ":::"]
    return "\n".join(overview + [""] + sections)


try:
    print(build_markdown(download_repo()))
except Exception:
    # On CI an empty overview must not be published silently; locally (e.g.
    # offline) the rest of the handbook should still render.
    if os.environ.get("CI"):
        raise
    print(
        "::: {.callout-warning}\n"
        "The list of skills could not be fetched when this page was rendered. "
        f"See the [group-skills repository]({REPO_URL}) instead.\n"
        ":::"
    )
```

## Contributing

New skills and improvements to the existing ones are welcome, see
[CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/tolborg-group/group-skills/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
in the repository.
